verdict.rationale: A Git forge hosting user code could plausibly offer an AI-training opt-out or a no-training policy, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses whether user data is used for AI model training or how to opt out. The MCP repository-access scoping controls which repositories connected AI tools can read, which is an adjacent control and not a training-data guarantee.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
